summary: Post-repair driver stack corruption causes Windows Recovery boot loop on depot-refurbished Precision 5570
description:
Issue summary:
After a routine depot mainboard replacement and re-image, several refurbished Dell devices fail to boot into Windows and drop to the Windows Recovery Environment (WinRE) loop. Devices crash in the boot phase after SCCM applies the monthly driver package.

Impact:
- Blocks re-provisioning from depot; 11 affected units identified in last 72 hours.
- Prevents handoff to employee provisioning; increases turnaround time and repair backlog.

Environment:
- Depot imaging pool in us-west backed by SCCM (collections: DEPOT-REFURBISH).
- Base image: service-image-2026-03-02 (corporate baseline).
- SCCM driver package: DELL-DRV-2026-03 (packaged by firmware team).

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1) Replace mainboard and perform hardware pre-check.
2) PXE boot into ServiceShare image v2026-03-02.
3) SCCM task sequence applies OS image, then driver package DELL-DRV-2026-03.
4) Reboot -> device enters WinRE with automatic repair loop.

Logs / evidence collected:
- WinRE SrtTrail.txt shows repeated CLSID/driver load failures referencing class GUID for storage/boot filters.
- Setupact.log from one device shows driver install step succeeded but later Boot Configuration Data entries were marked corrupt.
- SCCM content version matches packaging pipeline output: DELL-DRV-2026-03, hash confirmed.
- Dump of driver store (driverstore.txt) shows multiple copies of certain filter drivers with different INF timestamps.

Hypothesis so far:
- Driver package is overwriting boot-critical driver ordering (filter drivers for storage/volume) causing a corrupted driver stack on freshly provisioned hardware.
- The SCCM packaging process bundled an unsigned/experimental filter driver which replaced OEM boot filters.

Temporary mitigation attempted:
- Rolled back to service-image-2026-02-15 in depot -> devices boot normally (suggests change introduced in March image or driver pack).
- On affected units, ran offline DISM to remove specific filter driver and reapply OEM driver from driverstore -> boots recovered for 7/11 units.

Next steps recommended:
- Engineering to audit DELL-DRV-2026-03 package contents and the packaging pipeline.
- Add a post-driver-apply validation step in the SCCM task sequence to check boot-critical class driver ordering before final reboot.
- Rebuild driver package excluding boot-class filter drivers and push to a staging collection.
- Batch reflash affected devices after fix; escalate any hardware-failure escapes for physical rework.
comments: 2026-03-10 09:14 - Support (Aisha Patel): Ticket opened after depot reported 3 out of 5 refurbished Precisions failed to hand back to provisioning. Collected logs and quarantined driver package in depot. Escalating to imaging team.

2026-03-10 11:02 - Imaging (Marco Ruiz): Confirmed WinRE loop on two devices. Reverted to Feb image -> successful boots. Suspect DELL driver pack or image change. Pulling driverstore and srttrail logs into ticket.

2026-03-11 08:45 - Platform Eng (Leah Thompson): Reproduced in depot lab. Found duplicate storage filter drivers with different timestamps; one appears to be signed differently. Opening PR to strip filter drivers from the packaging pipeline. Marking driver package as quarantined in SCCM distribution points.

2026-03-11 14:22 - Repair Tech (Samir Nair): Of 11 units flagged, 4 required rework (reflash and mainboard reseat). 7 recovered after offline driver removal steps. Captured hardware serials for warranty follow-up.

2026-03-12 10:09 - Imaging (Marco Ruiz): Pack rebuilt as DELL-DRV-2026-03a excluding boot filters; staging collection tests (n=8) all booted successfully. Plan to schedule depot batch run tonight (11 devices).

2026-03-12 16:30 - Support (Aisha Patel): Noted runbook updates required. Adding follow-up task to add automated post-driver validation in task sequence and to add a canary gate for driver package promotion.
resolution: Root cause: SCCM driver package included boot-filter drivers that overwrote OEM driver ordering, corrupting the boot-critical driver stack during post-image driver stage. Fix deployed: rebuilt driver package (DELL-DRV-2026-03a) removing boot-class filter drivers and added a post-driver-apply validation step to the SCCM task sequence. Affected devices were batch reprocessed; 7 recovered via offline driver removal and 4 required physical rework and reseat. Updated Depot Repair Runbook and packaging checklist. Follow-up: create a monitoring alert for future driver package promotions and gating PRs for packaging changes.
